amendment_scope.change: Add acquired-corpus resampling to the primary descriptive interval; retain the original layout-only procedure as an explicitly secondary sensitivity.
amendment_scope.future_adoption_requirement: A separately adopted protocol must bind this complete artifact by path and SHA-256, together with the reviewed statistics implementation; this artifact provides no execution authority.
amendment_scope.original_uncertainty_text_verbatim: Pair by layout/source/seed; cluster-bootstrap18layout means with20000 draws seed202609081822, and independently report variability across3 acquired corpora. Courses with6layouts retain small-sample limitation.
amendment_scope.timing: Declared before primary acquisition outcomes, reserved evaluation outcomes, or adoption; prior development outcomes exist and remain development evidence.

bootstrap.corpus_weights: Per draw, multiplicity of each corpus index divided by 3.
bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive 95% percentile interval from paired crossed corpus/layout resampling, not a population-coverage or significance guarantee.
bootstrap.joint_weights: Product of corpus and layout weights; evaluation-seed weights remain equal.
bootstrap.layout_weights: Per draw, multiplicity of each layout index divided by 18.

sensitivity.definition: Use the same sampled layout weights with fixed corpus weights 1/3; this preserves the original V4 layout-only proposal as a named sensitivity, not the clarified primary interval.

bootstrap.shared_draws: Generate these two matrices once and reuse both unchanged for all 34 registered comparisons, both checkpoints, completion and time.
bootstrap.subgroup_scope: Primary intervals are for the entire 18-layout nominal panel. Report the declared layout-family strata descriptively; no additional subgroup interval family is introduced here.

completion_estimand.bootstrap_estimate: Average paired seed differences within each corpus/layout cell, then sum those cell means using the product sampled corpus/layout weights.
completion_estimand.complete_point_estimate: Equal-weight mean of left-minus-right differences over 3 corpora x 18 layouts x 2 evaluation seeds.
completion_estimand.failure_semantics: A fully measured invalid_initial_approach is a named task-criterion failure, not a fabricated collision/fall. Preserve the scorer/runner recorded category and its assigned denominator.
completion_estimand.outcome_coding: Verified task pass=1; verified task-criterion failure=0. Technical missing and not-run remain unknown assigned outcomes.
completion_estimand.unknown_bounds: For each policy S/N <= completion <= (S+U)/N, where U includes all assigned unknown outcomes. Contrast lower = left_lower - right_upper; upper = left_upper - right_lower. Never drop an assigned unknown episode.
completion_estimand.unknown_interval_rule: Withhold both crossed and layout-only completion intervals if any participating assigned outcome is unknown.
completion_estimand.unknown_point_rule: Report no complete-outcome mean difference if any participating assigned outcome is unknown; retain the lower/upper contrast bounds and measured-only summaries with explicit denominators.

infrastructure_reference_amendment.change: Update authoritative parent protocol and primary plan/expected model paths for infrastructure recovery; no statistical or scientific assignment changes.
infrastructure_reference_amendment.historical_parent_field: parent_v4_proposal remains the unchanged original V4 scientific-scope proposal.
infrastructure_reference_amendment.original_uncertainty_amendment_retained: OriginalV4 layout-only primary changed to crossed corpus/layout by clarificationV1; thisV2 changes neither procedure.
infrastructure_reference_amendment.reservation_reporting: Separate affected-corpus reservation, not imputed actual acquisition steps; does not alter the statistics estimator.

input_forms: paused evaluation_status event wrapper with receipt.report.rows
input_output_contract.paired_comparison_key: left, right, left_checkpoint, right_checkpoint; direction is always left-minus-right
input_output_contract.physical_evidence_boundary: The statistics CLI validates report identities and denominators; independent execution/source/physical admission remains the runner responsibility. A supplied statistics receipt is not simulator qualification.

limitations: Only three independent acquired corpora per arm: crossed bootstrap intervals can be unstable and are descriptive, not a large-sample guarantee.
Finite locked layouts, reused motion-source ancestry and ideal simulator sensing limit generalization.
M2/M4 are paired checkpoints, not independent replications.
No multiplicity adjustment: 34 descriptive intervals are not simultaneous significance claims.
Conditional successful-time differences cannot by themselves establish better passage capability.
This reporting clarification adopts neither the acquisition plan nor the reserved evaluation protocol.

per_corpus_and_learning_curve_reporting.cost_accounting: Baseline evaluation is recorded once. M2/M4 reuse a corpus trajectory; exporting, fitting or computing statistics adds no acquisition physics.
per_corpus_and_learning_curve_reporting.learning_curve_x: Use each checkpoint actual recorded acquisition physics steps; report M2 assigned maximum 27416 and M4 assigned maximum 46488 separately. Means across corpora do not replace the individual points.
per_corpus_and_learning_curve_reporting.learning_curve_y: Report completion means or bounds with assigned denominators and measured successful-time comparisons with their pair counts.
per_corpus_and_learning_curve_reporting.per_corpus: Report each corpus mean or completion bounds, matched time means/counts, and paired differences separately.
per_corpus_and_learning_curve_reporting.variation: Report across the three corpus means the mean, sample standard deviation (ddof=1), minimum and maximum; when unknowns exist, summarize lower and upper bounds separately.

time_estimand.bootstrap_estimate: Reweighted sum of mutually successful paired time differences divided by reweighted number of those pairs, using the same corpus/layout matrices as completion.
time_estimand.no_imputation: Do not assign success time to failure, unknown, or not-run episodes and do not compare unpaired sets of policy successes.
time_estimand.no_mutual_success_rule: If no mutually successful matched pairs exist, time mean and both intervals are null with a reason.
time_estimand.point_estimate: Mean left-minus-right measured successful passage time only over mutually successful matched corpus/layout/evaluation-seed cells.
time_estimand.shared_baseline_count: A baseline may participate in up to 108 paired cells but has at most 36 unique right-hand episodes; disclose both counts.
time_estimand.unknown_interval_rule: Any participating assigned unknown outcome withholds both time intervals even if observed mutually successful pairs exist; their mean and counts remain explicitly descriptive.
time_estimand.zero_support_rule: For each bootstrap scheme independently, if any of its 20000 draws has zero mutually successful support, withhold that entire time interval, report its zero-support draw count and reason. Never discard/redraw empty draws or condition the interval on nonempty draws.

units.checkpoint_dependence: M2 and M4 share one acquisition trajectory; there are three independently acquired corpora per arm, not six independent checkpoint corpora.
units.evaluation_seed_dependence: Keep both evaluation seeds together within each sampled layout; neither seed is an independent scene sample.
units.paired_arm_blocks: Use the same acquired-corpus seed block across compared arms and checkpoints, and the same layout block across every policy.
units.shared_baselines: Each baseline has 36 unique physical episodes. Broadcast its layout-by-seed outcomes for algebraic comparison with three corpora; never create, independently sample, or count additional baseline replicates.
